footnote_text: The sale reported in this Form 4 was effected pursuant to a preexisting Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted by the Reporting Person on January 24, 2026, prior to the recent volatility in Progress Software Corporation's stock price and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. || This tranche of the sale was executed in multiple trades at prices ranging from $43.13 to $43.75 per share.
